name: git-relay
description: Git worktree change awareness, GitHub branch monitoring, and opt-in fast-forward synchronization for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Monitor local and GitHub branches, deliver relevant upstream changes between coding agents, and optionally fast-forward a clean local branch. Automatic synchronization is off by default.
defaultPrompt: Check my worktrees and local and GitHub branch status.
Monitor branch changes with automatic synchronization disabled.
Explain GitRelay commands and safe branch synchronization.
